subject.title: fix(sweep): allow PR review lease comments

question: Should this short-lived review-shard token receive Pull requests write permission under a monitored post-merge proof override?
rationale: The code change is narrow and supported by the failure evidence, but only a maintainer can authorize the additional GitHub App mutation capability and accept deployment-dependent proof.

options.title: Approve monitored rollout
options.body: Record the proof override in a maintainer-authored comment or label, merge the narrow permission change, and capture redacted PR and issue comment evidence from the first normal run.

options.title: Wait for deployed proof
options.body: Hold the PR until staging, shadow deployment, or another maintainer-controlled environment demonstrates the real App-token comment path before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve monitored rollout
recommendation.body: Record the proof override in a maintainer-authored comment or label, merge the narrow permission change, and capture redacted PR and issue comment evidence from the first normal run.
